original: The Central Authority shall consist of a Chief Commissioner and such number of other Commissioners as may be prescribed, to be appointed by the Central Government to exercise the powers and discharge the functions under this Act.
simplification: The Central Authority is run by a Chief Commissioner and some other Commissioners chosen by the central government.

original: The Central Authority shall consist of a Chief Commissioner and such number of other Commissioners as may be prescribed, to be appointed by the Central Government to exercise the powers and discharge the functions under this Act.
simplification: The Central Authority will be made up of a Chief Commissioner and a prescribed number of other Commissioners, all appointed by the Central Government to use the powers and carry out the duties under this Act.

original: The Central Authority shall consist of a Chief Commissioner and such number of other Commissioners as may be prescribed, to be appointed by the Central Government to exercise the powers and discharge the functions under this Act.
simplification: The Central Authority will not be made up of a Chief Commissioner and a prescribed number of other Commissioners, all appointed by the Central Government to use the powers and carry out the duties under this Act.

original: The Central Authority shall regulate the procedure for transaction of its business and allocation of its business amongst the Chief Commissioner and Commissioners as may be specified by regulations.
simplification: The Central Authority decides how it does its work and who among its leaders does which job.

original: The Central Authority shall regulate the procedure for transaction of its business and allocation of its business amongst the Chief Commissioner and Commissioners as may be specified by regulations.
simplification: The Central Authority will set its own procedure for carrying out its work and for dividing the work between the Chief Commissioner and the Commissioners, as laid down in regulations.

original: The Central Authority shall regulate the procedure for transaction of its business and allocation of its business amongst the Chief Commissioner and Commissioners as may be specified by regulations.
simplification: The Central Authority will not set its own procedure for carrying out its work and for dividing the work between the Chief Commissioner and the Commissioners, as laid down in regulations.

original: Subject to the other provisions of this Act, the District Commission shall have jurisdiction to entertain complaints where the value of the goods or services paid as consideration does not exceed one crore rupees: Provided that where the Central Government deems it necessary so to do, it may prescribe such other value, as it deems fit.
simplification: The District Commission handles complaints about things or services that cost up to one crore rupees. The central government can change this amount.

original: Subject to the other provisions of this Act, the District Commission shall have jurisdiction to entertain complaints where the value of the goods or services paid as consideration does not exceed one crore rupees: Provided that where the Central Government deems it necessary so to do, it may prescribe such other value, as it deems fit.
simplification: Subject to the other provisions of this Act, the District Commission can hear complaints where the value of the goods or services paid for is not more than one crore rupees. However, the Central Government may set a different value if it thinks it is necessary.

original: Subject to the other provisions of this Act, the District Commission shall have jurisdiction to entertain complaints where the value of the goods or services paid as consideration does not exceed one crore rupees: Provided that where the Central Government deems it necessary so to do, it may prescribe such other value, as it deems fit.
simplification: Subject to the other provisions of this Act, the District Commission can hear complaints where the value of the goods or services paid for is not more than two crore rupees. However, the Central Government may set a different value if it thinks it is necessary.

original: The District Commission shall, on admission of a complaint, or in respect of cases referred for mediation on failure of settlement by mediation, proceed with such complaint.
simplification: Once the District Commission accepts a complaint, or if talks to settle it fail, it starts working on the case.

original: The District Commission shall, on admission of a complaint, or in respect of cases referred for mediation on failure of settlement by mediation, proceed with such complaint.
simplification: After admitting a complaint, or when a case sent for mediation has not been settled, the District Commission will go ahead with the complaint.

original: The District Commission shall, on admission of a complaint, or in respect of cases referred for mediation on failure of settlement by mediation, proceed with such complaint.
simplification: After admitting a complaint, or when a case sent for mediation has been settled, the District Commission will go ahead with the complaint.

original: The State Commission shall ordinarily function at the State capital and perform its functions at such other places as the State Government may in consultation with the State Commission notify in the Official Gazette: Provided that the State Government may, by notification, establish regional benches of the State Commission, at such places, as it deems fit.
simplification: The State Commission usually works in the state capital, but it can also work in other places the government chooses.

original: The State Commission shall ordinarily function at the State capital and perform its functions at such other places as the State Government may in consultation with the State Commission notify in the Official Gazette: Provided that the State Government may, by notification, establish regional benches of the State Commission, at such places, as it deems fit.
simplification: The State Commission will usually work from the State capital. It can also work at other places that the State Government, after consulting the State Commission, announces in the Official Gazette. The State Government may also set up regional benches of the State Commission at places it thinks suitable.

original: The State Commission shall ordinarily function at the State capital and perform its functions at such other places as the State Government may in consultation with the State Commission notify in the Official Gazette: Provided that the State Government may, by notification, establish regional benches of the State Commission, at such places, as it deems fit.
simplification: The State Commission will not usually work from the State capital. It can also work at other places that the State Government, after consulting the State Commission, announces in the Official Gazette. The State Government may also set up regional benches of the State Commission at places it thinks suitable.

original: The provisions relating to complaints under sections 35, 36, 37, 38 and 39 shall, with such modifications as may be considered necessary, be applicable to the disposal of complaints by the National Commission.
simplification: The National Commission handles complaints using the same rules as the smaller consumer commissions.

original: The provisions relating to complaints under sections 35, 36, 37, 38 and 39 shall, with such modifications as may be considered necessary, be applicable to the disposal of complaints by the National Commission.
simplification: The rules about complaints in sections 35, 36, 37, 38 and 39 will also apply, with any needed changes, when the National Commission deals with complaints.

original: The provisions relating to complaints under sections 35, 36, 37, 38 and 39 shall, with such modifications as may be considered necessary, be applicable to the disposal of complaints by the National Commission.
simplification: The rules about complaints in sections 35, 36, 37, 38 and 78 will also apply, with any needed changes, when the National Commission deals with complaints.

original: Notwithstanding anything contained in the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, the District Commission, the State Commission or the National Commission, as the case may be, shall have the power of a Judicial Magistrate of first class for the trial of offences under sub-section (1), and on conferment of such powers, the District Commission or the State Commission or the National Commission, as the case may be, shall be deemed to be a Judicial Magistrate of first class for the purposes of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973.
simplification: Consumer commissions can act like criminal judges when someone breaks their orders.

original: Notwithstanding anything contained in the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, the District Commission, the State Commission or the National Commission, as the case may be, shall have the power of a Judicial Magistrate of first class for the trial of offences under sub-section (1), and on conferment of such powers, the District Commission or the State Commission or the National Commission, as the case may be, shall be deemed to be a Judicial Magistrate of first class for the purposes of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973.
simplification: Even though the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 says otherwise, the District, State or National Commission will have the powers of a Judicial Magistrate of first class to try offences under sub-section (1). Once it has these powers, the Commission will be treated as a Judicial Magistrate of first class under that Code.

original: Notwithstanding anything contained in the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, the District Commission, the State Commission or the National Commission, as the case may be, shall have the power of a Judicial Magistrate of first class for the trial of offences under sub-section (1), and on conferment of such powers, the District Commission or the State Commission or the National Commission, as the case may be, shall be deemed to be a Judicial Magistrate of first class for the purposes of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973.
simplification: Even though the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 says otherwise, the District, State or National Commission will have the powers of a Judicial Magistrate of first class to try offences under sub-section (1). Once it has these powers, the Commission will not be treated as a Judicial Magistrate of first class under that Code.

original: Notwithstanding anything contained in the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, where an order is passed under sub-section (1) of section 72, an appeal shall lie, both on facts and on law from— (a) the order made by the District Commission to the State Commission; (b) the order made by the State Commission to the National Commission; and (c) the order made by the National Commission to the Supreme Court.
simplification: If you disagree with a punishment order from a consumer commission, you can appeal to the next higher one. The highest step is the Supreme Court.

original: Notwithstanding anything contained in the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, where an order is passed under sub-section (1) of section 72, an appeal shall lie, both on facts and on law from— (a) the order made by the District Commission to the State Commission; (b) the order made by the State Commission to the National Commission; and (c) the order made by the National Commission to the Supreme Court.
simplification: Even though the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 says otherwise, when an order is made under sub-section (1) of section 72, an appeal can be made on both facts and law: (a) from an order of the District Commission to the State Commission; (b) from an order of the State Commission to the National Commission; and (c) from an order of the National Commission to the Supreme Court.

original: Notwithstanding anything contained in the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, where an order is passed under sub-section (1) of section 72, an appeal shall lie, both on facts and on law from— (a) the order made by the District Commission to the State Commission; (b) the order made by the State Commission to the National Commission; and (c) the order made by the National Commission to the Supreme Court.
simplification: Even though the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 says otherwise, when an order is made under sub-section (1) of section 72, an appeal must be made on both facts and law: (a) from an order of the District Commission to the State Commission; (b) from an order of the State Commission to the National Commission; and (c) from an order of the National Commission to the Supreme Court.

original: Where the consumer dispute is settled only in part, the District Commission or the State Commission or the National Commission, as the case may be, shall record settlement of the issues which have been so settled and continue to hear other issues involved in such consumer dispute.
simplification: If only some problems are solved, the commission writes those down and keeps working on the rest.

original: Where the consumer dispute is settled only in part, the District Commission or the State Commission or the National Commission, as the case may be, shall record settlement of the issues which have been so settled and continue to hear other issues involved in such consumer dispute.
simplification: If only part of the consumer dispute is settled, the District, State or National Commission will record the settlement of those issues and continue hearing the remaining issues in the dispute.

original: Where the consumer dispute is settled only in part, the District Commission or the State Commission or the National Commission, as the case may be, shall record settlement of the issues which have been so settled and continue to hear other issues involved in such consumer dispute.
simplification: If part of the consumer dispute is settled, the District, State or National Commission will record the settlement of those issues and continue hearing the remaining issues in the dispute.

original: A product liability action may be brought by a complainant against a product manufacturer or a product service provider or a product seller, as the case may be, for any harm caused to him on account of a defective product.
simplification: If a broken or faulty product hurts you, you can take action against the company that made it, sold it or serviced it.

original: A product liability action may be brought by a complainant against a product manufacturer or a product service provider or a product seller, as the case may be, for any harm caused to him on account of a defective product.
simplification: A complainant can bring a product liability case against a product manufacturer, a product service provider or a product seller for any harm caused to them by a defective product.

original: A product liability action may be brought by a complainant against a product manufacturer or a product service provider or a product seller, as the case may be, for any harm caused to him on account of a defective product.
simplification: A complainant can bring a product liability case against a product manufacturer, a product service provider or a product seller for certain harm caused to them by a defective product.

original: A product manufacturer shall be liable in a product liability action, if— (a) the product contains a manufacturing defect; or (b) the product is defective in design; or (c) there is a deviation from manufacturing specifications; or (d) the product does not conform to the express warranty; or (e) the product fails to contain adequate instructions of correct usage to prevent any harm or any warning regarding improper or incorrect usage.
simplification: A company that makes a product has to pay if the product is badly made, badly designed, or doesn't match its promises. It also has to pay if it didn't give clear instructions or warnings to keep people safe.

original: A product manufacturer shall be liable in a product liability action, if— (a) the product contains a manufacturing defect; or (b) the product is defective in design; or (c) there is a deviation from manufacturing specifications; or (d) the product does not conform to the express warranty; or (e) the product fails to contain adequate instructions of correct usage to prevent any harm or any warning regarding improper or incorrect usage.
simplification: A product manufacturer is responsible in a product liability case if: (a) the product has a manufacturing defect; (b) the product's design is faulty; (c) the product was not made according to its specifications; (d) the product does not match the express warranty; or (e) the product does not include enough instructions on correct use to prevent harm, or warnings about wrong or improper use.

original: A product manufacturer shall be liable in a product liability action, if— (a) the product contains a manufacturing defect; or (b) the product is defective in design; or (c) there is a deviation from manufacturing specifications; or (d) the product does not conform to the express warranty; or (e) the product fails to contain adequate instructions of correct usage to prevent any harm or any warning regarding improper or incorrect usage.
simplification: A product manufacturer is responsible in a product liability case if: (a) the product has a manufacturing defect; (b) the product's design is faulty; (c) the product was not made according to its specifications; (d) the product does not match the express warranty; or (e) the product does include enough instructions on correct use to prevent harm, or warnings about wrong or improper use.

original: Whoever, fails to comply with any direction of the Central Authority under sections 20 and 21, shall be punished with imprisonment for a term which may extend to six months or with fine which may extend to twenty lakh rupees, or with both.
simplification: If you ignore an order from the Central Authority, you can go to jail or pay a big fine.

original: Whoever, fails to comply with any direction of the Central Authority under sections 20 and 21, shall be punished with imprisonment for a term which may extend to six months or with fine which may extend to twenty lakh rupees, or with both.
simplification: Anyone who does not follow a direction of the Central Authority under sections 20 and 21 can be punished with up to six months in prison, a fine of up to twenty lakh rupees, or both.

original: Whoever, fails to comply with any direction of the Central Authority under sections 20 and 21, shall be punished with imprisonment for a term which may extend to six months or with fine which may extend to twenty lakh rupees, or with both.
simplification: Anyone who does not follow a direction of the Central Authority under sections 20 and 21 can be punished with up to three months in prison, a fine of up to twenty lakh rupees, or both.

original: A notice given under sub-section (3) shall include a statement that the third party to whom the notice is given is entitled to prefer an appeal under section 19 against the decision.
simplification: When someone else's information is involved, the notice sent to that person must tell them they are allowed to challenge the decision.

original: A notice given under sub-section (3) shall include a statement that the third party to whom the notice is given is entitled to prefer an appeal under section 19 against the decision.
simplification: A notice sent under sub-section (3) must tell the third party that they have the right to appeal against the decision under section 19.

original: A notice given under sub-section (3) shall include a statement that the third party to whom the notice is given is entitled to prefer an appeal under section 19 against the decision.
simplification: A notice sent under sub-section (3) may tell the third party that they have the right to appeal against the decision under section 19.

original: उपधारा (3) के अधीन दी गई सूचना में यह कथन भी सम्मिलित होगा कि वह पर व्यक्ति, जिसे सूचना दी गई है, धारा 19 के अधीन उक्त विनिश्चय के विरुद्ध अपील करने का हकदार है।
simplification: जिस दूसरे व्यक्ति की जानकारी की बात है, उसे भेजे गए नोटिस में बताया जाएगा कि वह फ़ैसले को चुनौती दे सकता है।

original: उपधारा (3) के अधीन दी गई सूचना में यह कथन भी सम्मिलित होगा कि वह पर व्यक्ति, जिसे सूचना दी गई है, धारा 19 के अधीन उक्त विनिश्चय के विरुद्ध अपील करने का हकदार है।

original: उपधारा (3) के अधीन दी गई सूचना में यह कथन भी सम्मिलित होगा कि वह पर व्यक्ति, जिसे सूचना दी गई है, धारा 19 के अधीन उक्त विनिश्चय के विरुद्ध अपील करने का हकदार है।

original: The general superintendence, direction and management of the affairs of the Central Information Commission shall vest in the Chief Information Commissioner who shall be assisted by the Information Commissioners and may exercise all such powers and do all such acts and things which may be exercised or done by the Central Information Commission autonomously without being subjected to directions by any other authority under this Act.
simplification: The Chief Information Commissioner is the boss of the Central Information Commission, and the other commissioners help. The Commission works on its own without anyone else telling it what to do.

original: The general superintendence, direction and management of the affairs of the Central Information Commission shall vest in the Chief Information Commissioner who shall be assisted by the Information Commissioners and may exercise all such powers and do all such acts and things which may be exercised or done by the Central Information Commission autonomously without being subjected to directions by any other authority under this Act.
simplification: The Chief Information Commissioner is in overall charge of running the Central Information Commission, with help from the Information Commissioners. The Chief Information Commissioner may use all the powers of the Commission and do everything the Commission can do, independently and without taking orders from any other authority under this Act.

original: The general superintendence, direction and management of the affairs of the Central Information Commission shall vest in the Chief Information Commissioner who shall be assisted by the Information Commissioners and may exercise all such powers and do all such acts and things which may be exercised or done by the Central Information Commission autonomously without being subjected to directions by any other authority under this Act.
simplification: The Chief Information Commissioner is in overall charge of running the Central Information Commission, with help from the Information Commissioners. The Chief Information Commissioner may use all the powers of the Commission and do everything the Commission can do, independently and without taking orders from certain other authority under this Act.

original: केन्द्रीय सूचना आयोग के कार्यों का साधारण अधीक्षण, निदेशन और प्रबंधन, मुख्य सूचना आयुक्त में निहित होगा, जिसकी सहायता सूचना आयुक्तों द्वारा की जाएगी और वह ऐसी सभी शक्तियों का प्रयोग और ऐसे सभी कार्य और बातें कर सकेगा, जिनका केन्द्रीय सूचना आयोग द्वारा स्वतंत्र रूप से इस अधिनियम के अधीन किसी अन्य प्राधिकारी के निदेशों के अधीन रहे बिना प्रयोग किया जा सकता है या जो की जा सकती है।
simplification: मुख्य सूचना आयुक्त केंद्रीय सूचना आयोग को चलाते हैं और दूसरे आयुक्त उनकी मदद करते हैं। आयोग अपने फ़ैसले खुद लेता है, कोई और उसे आदेश नहीं देता।

original: केन्द्रीय सूचना आयोग के कार्यों का साधारण अधीक्षण, निदेशन और प्रबंधन, मुख्य सूचना आयुक्त में निहित होगा, जिसकी सहायता सूचना आयुक्तों द्वारा की जाएगी और वह ऐसी सभी शक्तियों का प्रयोग और ऐसे सभी कार्य और बातें कर सकेगा, जिनका केन्द्रीय सूचना आयोग द्वारा स्वतंत्र रूप से इस अधिनियम के अधीन किसी अन्य प्राधिकारी के निदेशों के अधीन रहे बिना प्रयोग किया जा सकता है या जो की जा सकती है।
simplification: केन्द्रीय सूचना आयोग के कामकाज की देखरेख, निर्देशन और प्रबंधन मुख्य सूचना आयुक्त के पास होगा, और सूचना आयुक्त उसकी मदद करेंगे। मुख्य सूचना आयुक्त आयोग की सभी शक्तियों का इस्तेमाल कर सकेगा और वे सभी काम कर सकेगा जो आयोग स्वतंत्र रूप से, किसी दूसरे प्राधिकारी के निर्देश के बिना, इस अधिनियम के तहत कर सकता है।

original: केन्द्रीय सूचना आयोग के कार्यों का साधारण अधीक्षण, निदेशन और प्रबंधन, मुख्य सूचना आयुक्त में निहित होगा, जिसकी सहायता सूचना आयुक्तों द्वारा की जाएगी और वह ऐसी सभी शक्तियों का प्रयोग और ऐसे सभी कार्य और बातें कर सकेगा, जिनका केन्द्रीय सूचना आयोग द्वारा स्वतंत्र रूप से इस अधिनियम के अधीन किसी अन्य प्राधिकारी के निदेशों के अधीन रहे बिना प्रयोग किया जा सकता है या जो की जा सकती है।
simplification: केन्द्रीय सूचना आयोग के कामकाज की देखरेख, निर्देशन और प्रबंधन मुख्य सूचना आयुक्त के पास होगा, और सूचना आयुक्त उसकी मदद करेंगे। मुख्य सूचना आयुक्त आयोग की सभी शक्तियों का इस्तेमाल कर सकेगा और वे कुछ काम कर सकेगा जो आयोग स्वतंत्र रूप से, किसी दूसरे प्राधिकारी के निर्देश के बिना, इस अधिनियम के तहत कर सकता है।

original: The Chief Information Commissioner or an Information Commissioner shall before he enters upon his office make and subscribe before the President or some other person appointed by him in that behalf, an oath or affirmation according to the form set out for the purpose in the First Schedule.
simplification: Before they start their job, the information commissioners have to make a formal promise in front of the President or someone the President chooses.

original: The Chief Information Commissioner or an Information Commissioner shall before he enters upon his office make and subscribe before the President or some other person appointed by him in that behalf, an oath or affirmation according to the form set out for the purpose in the First Schedule.
simplification: Before starting work, the Chief Information Commissioner or an Information Commissioner must take an oath or affirmation in front of the President or a person the President appoints for this. The oath must follow the form given in the First Schedule.

original: The Chief Information Commissioner or an Information Commissioner shall before he enters upon his office make and subscribe before the President or some other person appointed by him in that behalf, an oath or affirmation according to the form set out for the purpose in the First Schedule.
simplification: Before starting work, the Chief Information Commissioner or an Information Commissioner may take an oath or affirmation in front of the President or a person the President appoints for this. The oath must follow the form given in the First Schedule.

original: मुख्य सूचना आयुक्त या कोई सूचना आयुक्त, अपना पद ग्रहण करने से पूर्व राष्ट्रपति या उसके द्वारा इस निमित्त प्राधिकृत किसी अन्य व्यक्ति के समक्ष, पहली अनुसूची में इस प्रयोजन के लिए उपवर्णित प्ररूप के अनुसार एक शपथ या प्रतिज्ञान लेगा और उस पर हस्ताक्षर करेगा।

original: प्रत्येक लोक प्राधिकारी, इस अधिनियम के अधिनियमन के सौ दिन के भीतर सभी प्रशासनिक एककों या उसके अधीन कार्यालयों में, यथास्थिति, केन्द्रीय लोक सूचना अधिकारियों या राज्य लोक सूचना अधिकारियों के रूप में उतने अधिकारियों को अभिहित करेगा, जितने इस अधिनियम के अधीन सूचना के लिए अनुरोध करने वाले व्यक्तियों को सूचना प्रदान करने के लिए आवश्यक हों।
simplification: हर सरकारी विभाग को सौ दिन के अंदर काफ़ी सूचना अधिकारी चुनने होंगे, ताकि लोगों को जानकारी मिल सके।

original: सूचना के लिए अनुरोध करने वाले आवेदक से सूचना का अनुरोध करने के लिए किसी कारण को या किसी अन्य व्यक्तिगत ब्यौरे को, सिवाय उसके जो उससे संपर्क करने के लिए आवश्यक हों, देने की अपेक्षा नहीं की जाएगी।
simplification: जानकारी माँगने के लिए आपको कारण नहीं बताना पड़ता। बस संपर्क करने के लिए अपनी जानकारी देनी होती है।

original: सूचना के लिए अनुरोध करने वाले आवेदक से सूचना का अनुरोध करने के लिए किसी कारण को या किसी अन्य व्यक्तिगत ब्यौरे को, सिवाय उसके जो उससे संपर्क करने के लिए आवश्यक हों, देने की अपेक्षा नहीं की जाएगी।
simplification: सूचना माँगने वाले व्यक्ति से सूचना माँगने का कोई कारण नहीं पूछा जाएगा। उससे संपर्क करने के लिए ज़रूरी जानकारी के अलावा कोई और निजी जानकारी भी नहीं माँगी जाएगी।

original: Where access to the record or a part thereof is required to be provided under this Act and the person to whom access is to be provided is sensorily disabled, the Central Public Information Officer or State Public Information Officer, as the case may be, shall provide assistance to enable access to the information, including providing such assistance as may be appropriate for the inspection.
simplification: If someone who can't see or hear well asks for records, the information officer has to help them get the information. That includes helping them look at the records.

original: Where access to the record or a part thereof is required to be provided under this Act and the person to whom access is to be provided is sensorily disabled, the Central Public Information Officer or State Public Information Officer, as the case may be, shall provide assistance to enable access to the information, including providing such assistance as may be appropriate for the inspection.
simplification: If a person who must be given access to a record, or part of it, under this Act has a sensory disability, the Central or State Public Information Officer must help them get access to the information. This includes any help that is suitable for inspecting the record.

original: Where access to the record or a part thereof is required to be provided under this Act and the person to whom access is to be provided is sensorily disabled, the Central Public Information Officer or State Public Information Officer, as the case may be, shall provide assistance to enable access to the information, including providing such assistance as may be appropriate for the inspection.

original: जहां, इस अधिनियम के अधीन अभिलेख या उसके किसी भाग तक पहुंच अपेक्षित है और ऐसा व्यक्ति, जिसको पहुंच उपलब्ध कराई जानी है, संवेदनात्मक रूप से नि:शक्त है, वहां यथास्थिति, केन्द्रीय लोक सूचना अधिकारी या राज्य लोक सूचना अधिकारी सूचना तक पहुंच को समर्थ बनाने के लिए सहायता उपलब्ध कराएगा जिसमें निरीक्षण के लिए ऐसी सहायता कराना भी सम्मिलित है, जो समुचित हो।
simplification: अगर जानकारी माँगने वाला व्यक्ति देख या सुन नहीं सकता, तो सूचना अधिकारी को उसकी मदद करनी होगी। इसमें रिकॉर्ड देखने में मदद करना भी शामिल है।

original: जहां, इस अधिनियम के अधीन अभिलेख या उसके किसी भाग तक पहुंच अपेक्षित है और ऐसा व्यक्ति, जिसको पहुंच उपलब्ध कराई जानी है, संवेदनात्मक रूप से नि:शक्त है, वहां यथास्थिति, केन्द्रीय लोक सूचना अधिकारी या राज्य लोक सूचना अधिकारी सूचना तक पहुंच को समर्थ बनाने के लिए सहायता उपलब्ध कराएगा जिसमें निरीक्षण के लिए ऐसी सहायता कराना भी सम्मिलित है, जो समुचित हो।
simplification: अगर इस अधिनियम के तहत किसी अभिलेख या उसके हिस्से तक पहुँच देनी है और वह व्यक्ति संवेदी रूप से अक्षम है, तो केन्द्रीय या राज्य लोक सूचना अधिकारी उसे सूचना तक पहुँचने में मदद करेगा। इसमें अभिलेख के निरीक्षण के लिए उचित मदद देना भी शामिल है।
